question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Unsuspecting
solution:
The correct answer is: **Wary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"unsuspecting"** means not aware of the presence of danger; feeling no suspicion. (संदेह न करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The unsuspecting tourists fell victim to the pickpocket.
 
 
 
• **"Wary"** refers to being cautious and alert to possible dangers or problems. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example: **She was wary of strangers offering help in the deserted street.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'unsuspecting'** is **'wary'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Wary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Naive **(भोला): Showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment.

 
 
• **Example:** The naïve girl trusted everyone she met.
 
 
 
• **Trusting **(भरोसा करने वाला): Having or showing a belief in someone’s honesty or sincerity.
 
 
• **Example: **He was too trusting and often got deceived by others.
 
 
 
• **Unguarded** (असुरक्षित): Not protected or watched.
 
 
• **Example:** The unguarded gate allowed anyone to enter the premises.
